name: Wolf (Games-on-Whales)
description: Stream virtual desktops and applications (including games) from a Proxmox VE host to Moonlight clients. Backed by docker-lxc-daemon (LXC2Docker): the daemon runs on the host and each Wolf session launches as a sibling Proxmox CT with GPU passthrough. Includes the Wolf Den management UI.

notes.text: Runs on the Proxmox host, not in a single CT: docker-lxc-daemon takes over /var/run/docker.sock and Wolf sessions become sibling Proxmox CTs.
Needs a free static LAN IP for the Wolf CT (Moonlight/mDNS discovery) and a GPU on the host (NVIDIA/Intel/AMD).
Pair from Moonlight, then open http://<LAN_IP>:47989 for the PIN. Wolf Den UI on :8080.
